description: Sign the agent in to its DiviMail address and get the token needed to send, check the inbox, top up or pay. Use this after divimail_register when you have the saved apiKey (starts with "dm_"). Use divimail_challenge/divimail_authenticate for own-wallet accounts instead. No NEAR signature or service secret needed. Returns a JWT.

apiKey.description: The one-time apiKey returned by a provisioned divimail_register (starts with "dm_")

name: divimail_login
